briefdescription.para: Bridges WAL-based CDC events with schema-encoded output.

detaileddescription.para:
Wraps a ReplicationManager (or its CDCManager) and intercepts WAL entries. For each entry whose collection is registered, the bridge:
Resolves (or auto-registers) the collection's schema via SchemaRegistryClient.
Encodes the event using CdcSchemaEncoder.
Dispatches the resulting SchemaEncodedEvent to all registered subscriber callbacks.
